units.source_text: 我把手巾挂在衣架上的那一瞬间，道子一声不响地坐在棋盘对面，

en.t: The moment I hung the towel on the clothes rack, Michiko silently sat down across from the go board,

units.source_text: 她那茫然若失的目光落在膝上。

en.t: her dazed, lost gaze falling onto her lap.

units.source_text: 我移过身子，坐在她面前，

en.t: I shifted over and sat down in front of her,

units.source_text: 她也不瞧我一眼，也不说什么，只是诚惶诚恐地等待着。

en.t: but she did not even glance at me or say anything; she only waited in anxious, reverent fear.
